title: Accenture Technology Vision 2025: AI: A Declaration of Autonomy: Is trust the limit of AI’s limitless possibilities?
notes: Four trends ('4 Emerging Trends of AI, autonomy and trust'), numbered 01-04. Web page dated January 7, 2025; launched at CES. Labels printed as 'Name: subtitle'; subtitle in note. Quotes are the one-sentence deck under each trend on the web page. The PDF says 'in 25 years of producing the Technology Vision'. Survey figures with an explicit future horizon are in metric/value; others in note.

entries.label: The Binary Big Bang
entries.quote: As gen AI becomes central to enterprise tech, development costs plummet, new systems abound, and digital agents gain autonomy—transforming applications as we know them.
entries.subject: Generative AI in enterprise systems and AI agents
entries.metric: executives agreeing digital ecosystems will need to be built for AI agents as much as for humans
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'When AI expands exponentially, systems are upended'. Also: 77% agree AI agents will reinvent how their organization builds digital systems (no horizon).

entries.label: Your Face, in the Future
entries.quote: AI Agents can personalize customer interactions at scale, but brands must protect their unique voice to avoid becoming generic.
entries.subject: Personified AI and brand-specific AI agents
entries.metric: executives reporting a consistent personality will be important or very important to their customer-facing AI agents
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'Differentiating when every interface looks the same'. Present-tense survey: 80% agree chatbots that all sound the same create differentiation challenges.

entries.label: When LLMs Get Their Bodies
entries.quote: Robots with embedded LLMs have generalist versatility, enabling them to take on new tasks in human spaces beyond today’s highly-programmed use cases.
entries.subject: Foundation-model robotics
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'How foundation models reinvent robotics'. Survey: 74% of executives agree their organization sees the promise of adaptable and intelligent robots (no horizon).

entries.label: The New Learning Loop
entries.quote: When gen AI is diffused through an organization, every employee has the full power of their organization behind them, which expands the autonomy of both people and AI over time.
entries.subject: Generative AI and workforce learning
entries.metric: executives expecting employee tasks to moderately or significantly shift to innovation given gen AI automation
entries.note: Printed subtitle: 'How people and AI are defining a virtuous cycle of learning, leading, and creating'. Also: 68% report a need to upskill/reskill employees in gen AI tools within the next 3 years.
